content:
I use generative AI to help me code. I hear similar things from other fellow Dataverse devs. Should we make this more transparent for Dataverse? https://ai-declaration.org/

First heard about this from the good people at the NL eScienceCenter https://blog.esciencecenter.nl/posts/2026-04-23---provenance-in-the-age-of-ai-why-we-need-ai-declarations-for-/ (met Faruk in person at the deRSE26 conference in Stuttgart).

It says "Early adopters will be featured on this page with their project name and link."

No takers yet? :crazy:

Looks like the blog post says, "We are in the early stages of this, and we need a community to make it a standard."

Overall, I think it seems ok.

Have you seen the priority issues linked from the board? https://github.com/orgs/IQSS/projects/34?pane=info

There's one called "Dataverse AI Best Practices & Strategy": - https://github.com/IQSS/dataverse-pm/issues/522

Seems on-topic to me. Maybe you could add a comment.
